chapter: Savoy days, the Concord and business
title: The Copacabana and the World's Fair
summary: He played the Copacabana seven nights a week and the World's Fair before moving to the Concord.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I kept that, the small group, it must have been, I don't know, till about before I went into the Copacabana. I went in the Copacabana in 50, no, in '65. '65 or '64. I stayed two years. I had to come out cause 7 nights a week got to me. I was playing 7 nights a week. I came out the first year and I told them I had to get some rest. I couldn't get off, but I could let my men off and put someone in their place.
But, it kinda wore me out. Was that during the time they had the

World's Fair? I think that was the year. I was doing the World's Fair for 5 days a week, and doing the Copacabana for 7 days a week. I started at the World's Fair at 12 in the day and finished at 7 in the evening. I'd start up at the Copacabana at 10 at night and finished at 4. And, it got a little rough, you know.

So, I had to leave. Yeah, I left from, I went back in and went over the same thing I tried to stay. The old man wanted me to stay longer, as long as I wanted to. But, after 7 days a week, that was pretty rough.
So, I came out and I started doing the theaters. Not the theaters, the hotels, and a few clubs until I came here. And, they offered me to stay over if I would like to. They'd like to have me.
So, I thought it over and I would like to give it a chance. So, I've been here ever since on account of that.
